title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.21373v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning

translated_title: WeVisForensics：面向全能AI生成视频检测的自进化智能体
translated_abstract: 视频生成技术的最新进展呼吁基于明确取证证据的可靠检测方法。然而，现有方法主要依赖单次思维链推理，容易忽略短暂或局部的伪造痕迹，或者依赖预先定义的多智能体工作流，在选择相关检查时灵活性有限。即使引入自适应调查，仅优化调查策略也无法直接提升固定专家智能体的取证能力。我们提出WeVisForensics，这是一个智能体框架，其中主调查智能体协调一个自进化的取证检查子智能体库，涵盖视觉和音频线索。主调查智能体学习检查何种伪造痕迹类型、在哪个时间窗口进行检查以及何时得出结论，这些交互为两个层级的智能体提供共享反馈。我们的双时间尺度策略优化策略DTPO通过快速强化学习闭合了这一循环。
tldr: 提出WeVisForensics智能体框架，由主调查智能体协调涵盖视觉与音频线索的自进化取证检查子智能体库，并通过双时间尺度策略优化DTPO实现基于明确取证证据的AI生成视频全能检测。
en_tdlr: WeVisForensics is an agentic framework where a main investigator coordinates a self-evolving library of visual and audio forensic inspector sub-agents, with dual-timescale policy optimization (DTPO) enabling reliable AI-generated video detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence.
